mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an important aspect of customary land law, and it regulates how land devolves and is inherited by heirs of the original owner of the property."
Succession to land is an important aspect of customary land law, and it regulates how land devolves and is inherited by heirs of the original owner of the property.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a legal phenomenon which gives effect to and reflects the social, economic and sometimes political demands and perspective of the community concerned."
Land tenure is a legal phenomenon which gives effect to and reflects the social, economic and sometimes political demands and perspective of the community concerned.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a delicate one under customary law."
The position is a delicate one under customary law.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the Conveyancing and Real Property Act of 1882, Settled Land Act 1881, Fines and Recoveries Act 1888, Land Transfer Act etc."
Important examples of these laws are the Conveyancing and Real Property Act of 1882, Settled Land Act 1881, Fines and Recoveries Act 1888, Land Transfer Act etc.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the right of the first settler on land, who is exercising maximum rights of ownership and which is recognized by law."
Settlement is the right of the first settler on land, who is exercising maximum rights of ownership and which is recognized by law.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a forceful displacement of the original settler forcefully and establishing the conqueror's occupational rights on the land."
Conquest on the other land is a forceful displacement of the original settler forcefully and establishing the conqueror's occupational rights on the land.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a very important unit in customary law, and land is rarely held individually but collectively."
The family is a very important unit in customary law, and land is rarely held individually but collectively.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is known of any customary rules guiding land prior to this period."
Little is known of any customary rules guiding land prior to this period.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a temporary grant of use of land to another person."
Borrowing of land is a temporary grant of use of land to another person.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the eldest member of the family recognized or appointed to manage the family property."
The family head is the eldest member of the family recognized or appointed to manage the family property.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are defined, delineated and explained within the framework of the land tenure system."
Interests in land (if any) are defined, delineated and explained within the framework of the land tenure system.
fib: ______ is defined as "any person lawfully occupying land under customary law and a person using or occupying land in accordance with customary law and includes the sub-leases or sub-under lessee of a holder".
Occupier

Occupier is defined as "any person lawfully occupying land under customary law and a person using or occupying land in accordance with customary law and includes the sub-leases or sub-under lessee of a holder".
______ is the person who holds land under customary law, as tenant of the grantor.
customary tenant
The customary tenant is the person who holds land under customary law, as tenant of the grantor.
______ is the only proper authority within the community to allocate land to members of the community or outsiders.
chief
The chief is the only proper authority within the community to allocate land to members of the community or outsiders.
______ is a unique form of customary tenancy which operates in the Southeastern states of Nigeria - especially the Onitsha Area of Anambra State.
Kola Tenancy
A Kola Tenancy is a unique form of customary tenancy which operates in the Southeastern states of Nigeria - especially the Onitsha Area of Anambra State.
______ is the thing itself which is the subject of the right.
corporeal hereditament
A corporeal hereditament is the thing itself which is the subject of the right.
______ is the permanent transfer of land for monetary consideration or money's worth.
sale
A sale is the permanent transfer of land for monetary consideration or money's worth.
______ refers to those laws that were in force in England as of 1st January 1900.
Statutes of General Application
Statutes of General Application refers to those laws that were in force in England as of 1st January 1900.
______ is the person holding land as customary owner while the occupier is the customary tenant within the meaning of section 50 of the Act.
holder
The holder is the person holding land as customary owner while the occupier is the customary tenant within the meaning of section 50 of the Act.
______ is a physical object, capable of being possessed - this could be done in terms of building, trees, crops or other physical fixtures on it.
Land
Land is a physical object, capable of being possessed - this could be done in terms of building, trees, crops or other physical fixtures on it.
______ is any property capable of being inherited.
Hereditament
Hereditament is any property capable of being inherited.
